Direction for question:

Eight people, P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, and W, are seated around a circular table with some facing the interior and others the outside, but not always in that sequence. A maximum of two adjacent people can be facing the same way at once.

With their faces are in different direction, Q is positioned second to R's left. W does not sit next to R; and, two people are seated between Q and W. V, who is seated second to U's right, is seated opposite to W. U, who is seated just to the right of S and faces out of the table. Between S and T, who is facing the same way as S, there are two people seated. T is not seated next to Q.


Who sits opposite of S?
